name: KG identity sentence refresh
notes: [Created 2026-06-12, KG fragility review #1: label is a bad identifier.] Nightly 03:45 (after the KG drains, before card refresh at 04:30 so cards can read fresh sentences later): (re)generate identity sentences - graph-derived definite descriptions that uniquely identify each node's referent (Entity/Event/State/Goal/Concept). NULL-sentence backfill first by pagerank, then hash-stale nodes (label/era/anchor-edge drift). Embeds into node_identity_embeddings; resolution + merge judges read them. max_per_run 1500: high cap is harmless steady-state (only drifted nodes process; free local models) and lets the remaining type backfills finish IN-SERVER - external backfill processes writing chroma alongside the server corrupted the identity collection's hnsw index on 2026-06-12; the server is the ONLY chroma writer. Spec: scratch/IDENTITY_SENTENCE_SPEC.md.
